speaker: Marcus Delano Webb
cascadeSummary: We are advancing the Month-six disbursement batch to stabilize 12 additional households, bringing the total to 57 families protected. Simultaneously, we are launching a targeted canvass across West Oakland's slipping commercial blocks to accelerate outreach and ensure no eligible applicants are left behind. Every application is processed with precision to protect these futures.

statements.decision: Approved disbursement for 12 households and launched canvass outreach
statements.quote: Twelve more households have final approval for stabilization assistance—bringing us to fifty-seven families protected with zero compliance exceptions.
statements.fullStatement: The Month-six disbursement batch for the West Oakland Stabilization Fund is now audit-ready and moving forward. Twelve additional households will receive stabilization assistance, bringing the total number of families protected to fifty-seven. Every application has been processed with precision and certainty, ensuring compliance with all program requirements. We are also launching a targeted canvass across West Oakland's slipping commercial blocks to accelerate outreach and ensure no eligible applicants are left behind. Stability isn't just a milestone—it's a mandate.

trackerUpdates.MilestoneNotes: C105: Month-six disbursement approved for 12 households; total now 57 families stabilized.
